summary.intent: Update CodeRabbit config to increase file review limit and add path exclusions, then rebase the feature branch on top of the updated main.
summary.outcome: Config PR #297 merged to main, feature branch rebased successfully, CodeRabbit processing 136 of 140 files. Then removed .planning/** and .learnings/** exclusions directly on feature branch so those docs are available for context review.

repo: CodeRabbit config lives at .coderabbit.yaml and is read from main branch — changes must land on main to affect open PR reviews
path_filters with ! completely excludes files from CodeRabbit's context, overriding any path_instructions directives
.planning/** and .learnings/** directories exist and contain useful context for PR reviews
The repo has a change-detection CI step that skips most checks when only YAML files change

code.finding: path_filters exclusions prevent CodeRabbit from reading files even for context; path_instructions alone does not exclude files from processing

workflow: GitHub Actions can show 'in_progress' status after a job has already succeeded — rendering lag, not a real blocker
Git rebase auto-drops commits that are already upstream when the content is identical, cleaning up redundant config commits
For config-only changes that only need to affect a single PR, modifying the file directly on the feature branch avoids the branch/PR/merge/rebase cycle

friction: GitHub status checks showed 'in_progress' after job succeeded, causing confusion and unnecessary merge retries
Stale background task failure notification surfaced mid-session for an already-resolved conflict, creating noise
Auto-merge and admin merge both attempted before CI completed, requiring multiple merge attempts
Rebase conflict on .coderabbit.yaml required manual resolution — the file existed independently on both branches
open_items: PR #296 (phase-19.1-extract-core-sdk) review by CodeRabbit is in progress — 136 files selected for processing
After PR #296 merges, the .coderabbit.yaml on main will reflect the restored .planning/** and .learnings/** inclusions
